lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But for a long time, fifteen percent was the *usual* tip for good service.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In that same survey, more than *half* said they tip fifteen percent or less at a sit-down restaurant.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On a six dollar coffee, that old usual tip is just ninety *cents*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Next to those ninety cents, the smallest button asks for a dollar twenty, and the biggest a dollar *eighty*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So the cheapest button is already a *third* more than the old usual tip.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Here is the trick: the buttons quietly tell you what a *normal* tip is.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The shop picks the buttons, the screen shows them, and *your* choices start right there.
